notes.title: Get Ready for Our Next Adventure!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37757516/a0527b602f0e9628104cba9698b295d8aac47669.jpg[/img]

Dear Azure Community,

Exciting news: We're launching a new game, and we want you to be a part of it!

Introducing "The Raindrop: A Vocal Odyssey" - a mythological adventure with hand-drawn graphics and unique voice-control gameplay.

Several years have passed since the release of Azure. During this time, I went from being a game design student to becoming a professional game designer. Now, I lead a part-time indie team called HoHo Game Studio, which is just getting started.

Join us by:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2653990/The_Raindrop_A_Vocal_Odyssey/?beta=1]Wishlist the game! [/url] Stay updated on its release.
[url=https://discord.com/invite/3gqHZp8aK3]Join our Discord![/url] Connect with fellow players and get exclusive insights.

We also have a special announcement to share: Each month, HoHo Game Studio will contribute 5% of earnings to the United Nations Crisis Relief, providing support to those affected by wars, hunger, and natural disasters. This commitment applies to all our current and future games, and we will share our monthly donation updates on our social media platforms.

Let's create new memories together in this new game!

Best regards,
Hongke Luo - Creator of Azure
